items.bewering: Jou liggaamsbeeld is hoe jy jou eie liggaam sien. Dit gaan oor wat jy van jou lyf dink en hoe jy daaroor voel.
items.bron: Office on Women's Health (womenshealth.gov) and NEDC (nedc.com.au): body image is how you see your body and the thoughts and feelings you have about it (perceptual, cognitive and affective components). Mental Health Foundation UK: 'how we think and feel about our bodies'.

items.bewering: In Graad 5 het jy van jou selfbeeld geleer. Jou liggaamsbeeld is een deel van daardie groter prentjie van jouself.
items.bron: DBE, 2022 Graad 5 Lewensvaardighede Jaarlikse Onderrigplan, Kwartaal 1, Ontwikkeling van self: 'Positiewe selfbeeldvorming: Invloed op ander met betrekking tot selfbeeld' (education.gov.za). Body image as one component of self-image/self-esteem: Nemours KidsHealth 'Body Image and Self-Esteem'.

items.bewering: Rondom jou ouderdom begin die liggaam van baie kinders stadig verander.
items.bron: Normal puberty onset is 8-13 in girls and 9-14 in boys (Patient.info 'Normal and Abnormal Puberty'; population study PMC6378593). Grade 6 learners are about 11-12, inside both ranges; 'baie kinders' is correctly not 'alle'.

items.bewering: Jy groei dalk skielik vinniger en jou skoene raak gou te klein.
items.bron: PMC3034705 (shoe size and timing of the pubertal growth spurt): foot growth accelerates early in puberty, with peak increase in shoe size at 10.4 years in girls and 11.5 in boys, before peak height velocity.

items.bewering: Jy sweet meer as vroeër en die sweet kan nou 'n reuk hê.
items.bron: Nemours KidsHealth 'Hygiene Basics' and Cleveland Clinic 'Body Odor': at puberty sweat glands become more active and apocrine glands start working, and body odour begins. Strictly the smell forms when skin bacteria break the sweat down (ASM 'Microbial Origins of Body Odor'); 'die sweet kan nou 'n reuk he' is how paediatric sources themselves phrase it and does not mislead the learner, whose remedy (washing) is the correct one.

items.bewering: Puisies kom op jou gesig uit en hare begin onder jou arms groei.
items.bron: Acne affects about 85% of adolescents and begins at puberty (Nemours KidsHealth 'Acne'; Cleveland Clinic 'Acne'). Underarm hair is a pubertal change (Center for Young Women's Health 'Puberty'). Note: underarm hair usually comes later in puberty than the other changes listed, but the sentence sits under 'begin ... stadig verander' and makes no claim about order or that all of it happens at once.

items.bewering: By seuns word die stem dieper en dit kan eers kraak.
items.bron: Nemours KidsHealth 'Why Is My Voice Changing?': the larynx grows under testosterone, the voice deepens, and it commonly cracks for a few months while changing, typically between 11 and 15.

items.bewering: By meisies begin die borste ontwikkel.
items.bron: Cleveland Clinic 'Breast Development' and Texas Children's: breast development (breast buds) is often the first sign of puberty in girls, usually starting between 8 and 13.

items.bewering: Hierdie veranderinge begin nie by almal op dieselfde tyd nie.
items.bron: Patient.info 'Normal and Abnormal Puberty'; PMC6378593: the normal range of onset spans about five years in each sex, so children may develop several years earlier or later than friends.

items.bewering: In een klas is een kind dalk al lank en het hy 'n diep stem. Sy maat langsaan lyk nog amper net soos verlede jaar. Albei is normaal.
items.bron: Nemours KidsHealth (voice change can start from about 11, earlier for some) and Patient.info (boys' onset 9-14): in a class of 11-12 year olds an early-maturing boy with a deeper voice and a boy with no visible change yet are both within the normal range. 'dalk' keeps the example from implying it is typical.

items.bewering: Jou liggaam volg sy eie tyd en kan vroeer of later as die van jou maats begin verander. 'n Vroee begin beteken nie dat jy voor is nie. 'n Laat begin beteken ook nie dat jy agter is nie.
items.bron: Patient.info 'Normal and Abnormal Puberty'; Rady Children's 'Delayed Puberty': timing within the normal range is shaped by genetics, nutrition and weight and does not in itself indicate advanced or delayed development. The lesson does not claim that any timing whatever is normal, so it does not contradict precocious or delayed puberty as medical conditions.

items.bewering: Dikwels is dit net een foto wat uit 'n hele klomp gekies is.
items.blok: Foto's wat nie alles wys nie
items.bron: McLean et al. 2015, International Journal of Eating Disorders, 'Photoshopping the selfie' (photo investment = effort spent selecting which photos to share); MediaSmarts 'Body image - digital media' (curated, selected images); Media literacy material (heretohelp.bc.ca) on curated snapshots that hide the discarded shots.

items.bewering: Die mense is met goeie lig en van die beste hoek afgeneem.
items.blok: Foto's wat nie alles wys nie
items.bron: Educate Empower Kids 'Images in Advertising' and MediaSmarts 'Media Education and Body Image': advertising images are produced with special lighting, makeup and flattering camera angles before digital enhancement. 'van die beste hoek' reads as 'the most flattering angle', which is what these sources describe.

items.bewering: Daarna word die foto dikwels op 'n rekenaar verander of met 'n filter gladder gemaak.
items.blok: Foto's wat nie alles wys nie
items.bron: MediaSmarts 'Body Image - Traditional Media' (magazine images routinely photomanipulated with Photoshop); MediaSmarts 'Body image - digital media' (filters built into social apps); Perfect Corp / photo filter documentation (filters that smooth and retouch skin).

items.bewering: Die foto's wys ook meestal net 'n paar soorte liggame.
items.blok: Foto's wat nie alles wys nie
items.bron: PubMed 30511491, 'Body image diversity in the media: A content analysis of women's fashion magazines': low diversity in body size and age among models; ScienceDirect 2025 ten-year study of magazine advertisements on the absence of diverse models. 'meestal' is the right strength.

items.bewering: As jy jou lyf daarmee vergelyk, vergelyk jy dit met iets wat nie werklik so lyk nie.
items.blok: Foto's wat nie alles wys nie
items.bron: MediaSmarts 'Body Image - Traditional Media' (bodies 'too thin to be true' after manipulation) and NEDA 'Media and Your Body Image': retouched and selected images represent bodies that do not look like that in reality.

items.bewering: Familie, maats en bure het elkeen idees oor hoe 'n liggaam 'moet' lyk. ... Hierdie idees verskil van mens tot mens.
items.bron: Office on Women's Health 'Body image' and NEDC: body image is shaped by messages from family, peers, culture and media; EBSCO Research Starters 'Culture of beauty': ideals vary between cultures and people.

items.bewering: Hulle verander ook oor tyd en baie mense vind vandag ander dinge mooi as mense lank gelede.
items.bron: AMA Journal of Ethics (2019), 'What Historical Ideals of Women's Shapes Teach Us...'; HISTORY.com 'What Is Beauty? The History of Pursuing Ever-Shifting Ideals': body and beauty ideals have shifted substantially across eras.

items.bewering: Jy sorg vir jou lyf as jy genoeg slaap, goeie kos eet en gereeld beweeg.
items.bron: Nemours KidsHealth 'Eat, Play, Sleep (for Kids)': healthy food, daily activity and enough sleep are the three daily habits that keep the body (and mind) healthy.

items.bewering: 'n Daaglikse wasbeurt help teen sweet en liggaamsreuk.
items.bron: Nemours KidsHealth 'Hygiene Basics (for Teens)': bathe or shower every day with mild soap to wash away sweat and the bacteria that cause odour; HealthyChildren.org 'Body Odor in Kids & Teens'.

items.bewering: Jy kan ook met die verpleegster by die kliniek gaan praat.
items.bron: Western Cape Government 'Adolescent Health (Youth services)': Youth Zones (Adolescent and Youth-Friendly Services) at public clinics serve young people aged 10-24 with free, confidential health advice; National Adolescent and Youth Health Policy 2017 (health.gov.za) covers the same age group and lists puberty information among services. Clinic care in South Africa is nurse-led (Western Cape Government 'Child Health and Immunisation'). A Grade 6 learner (11-12) falls inside the served age range, and the sentence claims talking, not treatment, so the age-12 consent rule does not bear on it.

items.bewering: puisie: 'n Klein knoppie op die vel wat dikwels op die gesig uitslaan.
items.bron: Cambridge Dictionary 'pimple' (small raised spot on the skin); Cleveland Clinic 'Acne': pimples appear most commonly on the face, also chest, shoulders and upper back. 'dikwels op die gesig' correctly does not limit it to the face.

items.bewering: media: Plekke soos televisie, tydskrifte, advertensies en fone waar ons nuus en prente sien.
items.bron: Britannica Kids 'media' and Cambridge Dictionary 'media': the ways information is distributed to many people - television, radio, newspapers, magazines, the internet. The entry simplifies 'means' to 'plekke' and phones stand for the internet as reached by a child; the 'soos' list is illustrative and the definition does not fit anything media is not. Acceptable at Grade 6.

items.bewering: filter: 'n Hulpmiddel op 'n foon of rekenaar wat verander hoe 'n foto lyk.
items.bron: Computer Hope 'What Is a Photo Filter?'; Samsung support 'My Filters': a filter is a software effect that changes the look of a photo (colour, contrast, skin smoothing).

items.bewering: kliniek: 'n Plek in die gemeenskap waar mense gesondheidsorg kry, of hulle siek is of gesond.
items.bron: Western Cape Government 'Child Health and Immunisation' and SciELO SA 'Monitoring well-baby visits in primary healthcare facilities': South African primary health care clinics provide preventive and promotive care (immunisation, growth monitoring, family planning, check-ups) to people who are not sick, as well as treatment.

items.bewering: liggaamsbeeld: Hoe jy jou eie liggaam sien, en wat jy daaroor dink en voel.
items.bron: Office on Women's Health (womenshealth.gov) and NEDC: body image combines how you perceive your body with the thoughts and feelings you have about it. The entry matches the study-text definition in 'Hoe sien jy jou lyf?'.

opsomming: Every factual claim in the lesson checked out against medical, government and research sources, including the puberty ages, the clinic youth services for children 10 and up, and the Grade 5 self-image topic; the value statements about respect and acceptance are advice rather than facts and were not scored, and the lesson contains no analogy.
